title: Witness pencil drawings of lights over trees and yard, captioned "Drawings"
description: Two scanned pencil drawings separated by the caption "Drawings." The upper sheet shows a row of circles labeled "in front yard," trees labeled "From back yard" and "out back," a shaded oval with red dots labeled "in the sky," and a pale oval with yellow-shaded circles. The lower sheet contains two shaded sky scenes with clusters of circles above "Trees," with handwritten notes describing the lights moving away and being watched for about 20 minutes.
